Comprehensive market research on Smart Pet Hardware (Smart Automatic Pet Feeders, Smart Drinking Water Fountains, and Smart Pet Monitoring Cameras) suitable for a small breed dog like a Pomeranian. 
1. Smart Automatic Pet Feeders: Research top mainstream options such as PETKIT Fresh Element Solo / YumShare Dual-Hopper, PETLIBRO Granary / Air Smart Feeder, and Catit / Eufy Pet Feeders. Evaluate: kibble size compatibility (small kibble for Pomeranian), anti-jam mechanisms, camera/voice features, food bowl materials (304 stainless steel, ceramic), sealed freshness (desiccant, silicone seals), app features (scheduling, portion control, remote feed), power backup, cleaning ease, price, and long-term maintenance costs (desiccant bag replacements, cleaning time).
2. Smart Drinking Water Fountains: Research top options such as PETKIT Eversweet Solo SE / Eversweet 3 Pro / Wireless Pump series, PETLIBRO Dockstream / Capsule Wireless, Uahpet, and Catit PIXI. Evaluate: filtration systems (multi-stage carbon, ion-exchange resin), noise levels (dB level - critical for small skittish Pomeranian), pump design (wireless magnetic pump vs wired), material safety (BPA-free, food-grade 304 stainless steel or ceramic options), battery backup, app connectivity/water intake tracking, cleaning ease, price, and replacement filter costs / frequency.
3. Smart Pet Monitoring Cameras: Research top options such as Furbo 360° Dog Camera, Eufy Pet Dog Camera D605, Enabot Ebo Air / X, and Aqara Smart Cameras. Evaluate: 360-degree panning, night vision, treat tossing mechanism / anti-jamming, 2-way audio quality, AI bark detection / motion tracking, cloud subscription costs vs local storage options, app interface and reliability, build quality/safety for small dogs, price, and total cost of ownership.
Provide detailed comparative evaluations, pricing, specifications, pros/cons, maintenance costs, and explicit recommendations tailored to a small white Pomeranian.

Also evaluate auxiliary paw cleaning tools (automatic vs manual silicone cup paw washers like Dexas MudBuster or automatic rotating paw cleaners) and deep-cleaning lint/hair removers (ChomChom Roller, FurMagic).
2. Interactive Toys for Small Breed Dogs: Research interactive and smart toys suitable for a small, lively Pomeranian (small mouth size, high energy). Evaluate smart interactive toys like Wickedball / Wickedbone by Cheerble, PETKIT Smart Ball, Joyhound, Petoi, or Outward Hound puzzle toys (Nina Ottosson Level 1-3 puzzles), and Classic KONG Small / KONG Puppy / KONG Wobbler. Provide detailed comparative evaluations, product specifications, pricing, maintenance requirements, and explicit recommendations.

Pomeranian & Small Breed Specific Dog Foods: Research mainstream and premium dog food options including Royal Canin Pomeranian Adult (dry and wet formula), Orijen Small Breed Dog Food, Acana Small Breed / Free-Run Poultry, Open Farm Small Breed Dry Food, Wellness CORE Small Breed / Natural Grain-Free, Ziwi Peak Air-Dried Dog Food (Lamb/Beef/Mackerel), and Stella & Chewy's Freeze-Dried Raw / Small Breed Patties or Kibble.

- Coat & Skin Health: Omega-3 & Omega-6 fatty acids (EPA/DHA ratios, salmon oil, flaxseed), Biotin, Vitamin E, zinc, zinc proteinate, and protein sources (high digestibility, salmon, lamb, chicken, turkey) to maintain Xiaobai's double coat volume, softness, and luster.
- Tear Stain Management: Examine causes of tear staining in white Pomeranians (protein sensitivities, artificial colors/dyes, preservatives, wheat/corn/soy fillers, high iron or mineral imbalances, poor digestibility, yeast/bacterial interactions with porphyrins). Evaluate how each formula addresses tear stains through clean ingredient sourcing, exclusion of artificial additives, chelators, probiotic strains, and low-allergen protein profiles.
3. Kibble Dimensions & Feeding Suitability: Evaluate kibble size/shape for small Pomeranian jaws (preventing swallowing without chewing, dental plaque control).
4. Cost Analysis & Long-term Budget: Evaluate price per lb/kg, recommended daily feeding volume for a 2.5 kg - 3.5 kg adult Pomeranian, daily feeding cost, monthly food cost, shelf life, and storage requirements.
